questions.question: What is perimeter? Find the perimeter of a rectangle 30 cm long and 20 cm wide.
questions.expected_answer: Perimeter is the distance all the way around the outside of a shape. 30 plus 20 plus 30 plus 20 is 100 cm.

questions.question: A regular hexagon has sides of 8 cm. Find its perimeter and explain your method.
questions.expected_answer: All 6 sides are equal, so multiply one side by 6. 6 times 8 is 48, so the perimeter is 48 cm.

questions.question: An L-shaped garden bed has sides of 8 m, 4 m, 3 m, 2 m, 5 m and 6 m. How much fencing is needed?
questions.expected_answer: Add all 6 sides: 8 plus 4 plus 3 plus 2 plus 5 plus 6 is 28. The fence needs 28 m of wire.
